prompt:
A clean 2D pixel art sprite sheet for a classic top-down arcade racing game, strictly matching the 8-bit/16-bit pixel art style and color palette of the reference image. Hard sharp pixel edges only, NO anti-aliasing, NO blur.

LAYOUT: Arrange every sprite in a neat, evenly spaced grid with plenty of empty space between each frame so no sprites touch each other. Uniform pixel scale.

BACKGROUND: solid flat plain background behind the sprites (this will be removed later). No text, no captions, no labels, no letters except the flag letters described below.

REQUIRED SPRITES (all STRICTLY TOP-DOWN, viewed from directly above):

Row 1 - PLAYER (Blue Car), facing UP only: 2 frames (slight vibration, wheels moving).

Row 1 - ENEMY (Red Car), facing UP only: 2 frames (slight vibration).

Row 1 - STUNNED ENEMY, same red car silhouette facing UP but fully desaturated: frame 1 pure bright WHITE car, frame 2 light GREY car (2 blinking frames, no red, no rotation).

Row 2 - FLAGS (top-down/side pennant flag on a pole, lively wavy flapping animation, 4 frames each):
- Blank Yellow Flag: 4 wavy frames
- Yellow Flag with bold RED letter 'S': 4 wavy frames
- Yellow Flag with bold RED letter 'L': 4 wavy frames

Row 3 - GAS / SMOKE CLOUD (cream/pale-yellow puffy cartoon smoke, matching reference smoke), 6 frames: small puff -> growing -> medium cloud -> big thick fluffy cloud -> thinning -> fading away.

Row 4 & 5 - MASSIVE EXPLOSION & WRECKAGE, 10 frames sequence:
1: white ignition blast flash on the blue car with sparks
2: fire erupting outward
3: growing red/orange/yellow flames
4: massive roaring fireball beginning to consume the car
5: peak enormous fireball completely engulfing the car with debris and sparks shooting out
6: fireball churning, dense orange-red flames
7: flames dying into thick dark smoke
8: smoke thinning revealing black charred chassis
9: black burnt car wreckage with small smoke wisps
10: final black burnt car wreckage resting on the ground

Crisp retro arcade pixel art, hard edges, evenly spaced grid.
